headings: Safeguarding your assets. Ensuring your long-term success.
paragraphs: Welcome

Welcome to Sentinel Africa Consulting, we are a premier Risk Management Consultancy firm operating throughout Africa and beyond. With our extensive expertise in Risk Management; Information Security, Business Continuity, Enterprise Risk, and Data Privacy & Protection, we are committed to safeguarding your organization’s assets and ensuring its long-term success.

Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and ISO/IEC 27701 PIMS certifications. Headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, and with subsidiaries in Rwanda and Uganda, we have established a strong presence across the African region. Our team of experts possesses deep industry knowledge, enabling us to cater to a wide range of sectors in both the private and public domains.

sections.label: Our Approach to Risk Management
paragraphs: At Sentinel Africa Consulting, we approach risk management with a dual focus: protecting your existing value and fostering its growth. We believe in understanding the unique needs of each client and developing tailored solutions to address their specific challenges. By implementing sustainable and continuously improving management systems, we ensure that risk management becomes an integral part of your organization’s DNA.

Our core values of Integrity & Ethics, Speed & Flexibility, Building Meaningful Relationships, and Working in the Trenches guide us in our service delivery. We are dedicated to assisting our clients in building better-run organizations and achieving their goals. Our ultimate vision is to become The Advisor of Choice, Your Advisor of choice by providing unparalleled guidance and support.
As you explore our website, we hope you discover the qualities that set us apart as an outstanding service provider and an exceptional place to build a career.

hero.title: Why We Do It
hero.lead: Sentinel Africa Consulting was born out of a fervent desire to redefine risk management as a powerful and invaluable discipline. Having experienced both the misconceptions and the true value of risk management during their tenure in various corporate settings, the founders of this organization were driven to make a lasting impact.

sections.label: Born from practice. Driven to make a lasting impact.
headings: Born from practice. Driven to make a lasting impact.
paragraphs: Our story

In their roles as Risk Management practitioners, they witnessed the reluctance of some business managers who perceived risk management as an impediment to growth and an overly restrictive process. This perception sparked the founders’ aspiration to educate and evangelize the essence of risk management across organizations of all kinds.

Their day-to-day work fueled their passion to demystify the value proposition of effective risk management, aiming to empower individuals from diverse backgrounds to embrace its principles. Rather than imposing predefined risk assessments, the founders championed a participatory approach that benefits both organizations and consultants. This approach involves collaboratively uncovering the most fundamental risk areas and fully embracing the life cycle of risk management to unlock the true benefits of an embedded risk management framework.

hero.title: Rwanda DPP Registration
hero.lead: Introducing Sentinel Africa’s Rwanda DPP Registration Accelerator – Your Fast-Track to Compliance! Welcome to the Rwanda DPP Registration Accelerator, a cutting-edge solution designed to streamline and expedite registration so as to comply with the DPP law in Rwanda.

sections.label: About the accelerator
paragraphs: We understand that navigating the intricacies of registration can be daunting and time-consuming for organizations, especially those lacking the expertise and resources.
With our expertise and in-depth knowledge of the registration requirements, we offer a seamless journey to obtain your certificate of registration as a data controller or processor in Rwanda.

sections.label: Why do you need to register?
headings: Why do you need to register?
paragraphs: The law

Therefore, it is mandatory for any natural person, public or private corporate body intending to be a Data Controller or a Data Processor to register with the Data Protection and Privacy Office under National Cyber Security Authority (NCSA) and receive a registration certificate.

By registering and providing information about your data processing operations to the supervisory authority, you are making the first step towards compliance and contributing to a responsible, transparent, and accountable data ecosystem in Rwanda.
Article 29
Operating without a registration certificate is an administrative misconduct.

sections.label: Any Data Controller
paragraphs: Who is required to register?
is established or resides in Rwanda and processes personal data while in Rwanda;
is neither established nor resides in Rwanda, but processes the personal data of Data Subjects located in Rwanda.

sections.label: Ascertain If you are a Data Controller or Processor!
headings: Ascertain If you are a Data Controller or Processor!
paragraphs: Step one

You are required to register as a data processor or controller, you therefore need to ascertain if you are a controller or processor or both. We will help you ascertain that by simply answering a few questions. Click the link below and get to know in a few minutes.

sections.label: Get it right
paragraphs: How will we help?

In just five days, we’ll handle the entire process, from document preparation to application submission, allowing you to focus on your core business activities without disruptions. Rest assured, we’ll navigate every step with precision and care, ensuring your registration journey is smooth and successful.

items.text: You’ll provide us with your details and upload the necessary documents.
Our team of experts will meticulously review and correct any discrepancies.
We will then have you sign the required documents, then compile the documents into a comprehensive package for submission to the supervisory authority.
You will need to create an email and share the credentials, we will then share the documents for you via that email and inform you when your certificate is ready in a week.

sections.label: Here is a List of the Documents you will need to upload!
headings: Here is a List of the Documents you will need to upload!
paragraphs: Be prepared

Join numerous organizations in Rwanda that have already experienced the efficiency and convenience of the Rwanda DPP Registration Accelerator. Let us empower your compliance journey, so you can confidently operate within the regulatory framework and elevate your organization to new heights of data protection and privacy.

Partner with Sentinel Africa today, and embark on a fast track to DPP registration – unlocking compliance with ease and precision. Trust in our expertise, and together, we’ll achieve your compliance goals in record time.
Documents checklist

items.text: Letter of application addressed to the Chief Executive Officer of NCSA
Certificate of incorporation
License from Regulator (if applicable) e.g. license issued by RURA, MINICOM
Legal instrument establishing the entity (in the case of a public entity)
Contract with the representative (only for those Data Controllers/ Data Processors that are neither established nor reside in Rwanda but process personal data of Data Subjects located in Rwanda)
Any other supporting document (e.g. a contract between Data Controller and Data Processor, privacy notice)

sections.label: From a Talent Shield scholar
paragraphs: As a proud alumni of the Talent Shield program, I can confidently say that it has exceeded my expectations in every way. It has been a beacon of hope, a catalyst for growth, and a promise of a brighter future. Sentinel Africa has truly redefined sponsorship with Talent Shield, and I am excited to witness the positive impact it will continue to have on the lives of countless young individuals like me.

sections.label: Untapped potential exists in every corner.
headings: Untapped potential exists in every corner.
paragraphs: About Talent Shield

At Sentinel Africa Consulting, we are driven by a profound belief in the power of talent and the transformational impact of education. We understand that untapped potential exists in every corner of our society, and we are committed to nurturing it.

The Sentinel Talent Shield Program extends a helping hand to gifted but underprivileged individuals who are either joining the university or in their first year at the university. Our mission is clear: to provide holistic support that not only covers tuition scholarships but also includes essential career guidance and development.

We are dedicated to creating a nurturing environment of empowerment through access to education and mentorship opportunities. If you are a talented, motivated individual who dreams of achieving greatness, we invite you to be a part of the Sentinel Talent Shield program.

sections.label: Who can apply
paragraphs: Eligibility criteria
Application stages
Stage .

items: You must have been admitted to a Kenyan University through KUCCPS.
You should either be joining your first year at the university or currently in your first year of study.
Ability to provide consent to share your information. For those under the age of 18 years, a guardian will have to assist in filling in the application form.
Be available for contact and provide references available for contact.
This will involve filling in the assessment on the basic criteria for shortlisting. The shortlisted applicant will proceed to Stage Two.
You shall be contacted through the contact details provided in Stage One to request supporting documents for review. The successful applicants shall proceed to Stage Three.
Applicants will be invited to an interview session. Interviews shall be conducted through videoconferencing.
A final round of checks will be conducted, and the award decision made. The successful applicant will be notified of the award.

sections.label: Privacy statement
paragraphs: The Sentinel Talent Shield Program is meant to grow and nurture special talent within Kenya. The application process will require that you share your personal data with us. We only collect information that we deem necessary in order to make the selection process possible and we will store and dispose of it securely at the end of the process.
